notes.title: Version 1.10 Released
notes.notes:
Version 1.10 has been released. The following items have been addressed:

[h2]Added[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added a PlayStation icon set for when a PlayStation controller is detected.
[*] Added the ability to change the volume level for music
[*] Added the ability to change the volume level for sound effects (SFX).
[/list]

[h2]Changed[/h2]

[list]
[*] Updated Steamworks SDK to version 1.57.
[/list]

[h2]Fixed[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where last display resolution used might not be valid on next launch (e.g. new monitor).
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.09 Released
notes.notes:
Version 1.09 has been released. The following items have been addressed:

[h2]Changed[/h2]

[h3]Environment[/h3]
[list]
[*] All "fire" environment props have had their overall look improved.
[/list]
[h3]UI[/h3]
[list]
[*] "Delete Data" button on Title screen has been renamed to "Restart".
[/list]

[h2]Removed[/h2]

[list]
[*] Removed 3rd party Analytics service (i.e. Legacy Unity Analytics) due to the service shutting down at end of 2022.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.08 Released
notes.notes:
Build 1.08 has been released. The following items have been addressed:

[h1]Added[/h1]

[h2]Controllers[/h2]

[list]
[*]   Support for PS5 controllers.
[*]   Support for Xbox Series X controllers.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.07 Released
notes.notes:
Build 1.07 has been released. The following items have been addressed:

[h1]Added[/h1]

[h2]Environment[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Added near miss shark attack upon sailing out to far in open water.
[*] Added new plants and wildlife to islands.
[/olist]
[h2]UI[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Added Sell All option in shop. Useful when selling large numbers of the same fish.
[*] Added the ability to launch Tutorial from system menu.
[/olist]

[h1]Changed[/h1]

[h2]UI[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Arrow keys are supported in all menus.
[/olist]
[h2]Shop[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Now has keys/button to buy/sell. Selecting an item no longer executes an action (buy/sell). It just selects the item.
[*] Fish are sorted to the top of the sell list in the shop.
[/olist]
[h2]Equipment[/h2]
[olist]
[*] "Fish" are sorted to the end of your equipment list.
[/olist]
[h2]Tutorial[/h2]
[olist]
[*] The completion of steps in the Tutorial is now saved. When completed it will no longer show at startup.
[*] The Tutorial can be relaunched from the menu.
[/olist]
[h1]Fixed[/h1]

[h2]Audio[/h2]
[olist]
[*] In some cases music appeared to be coming from a single point. This has been fixed.
[/olist]

notes.title: Version 1.06 Released
notes.notes:
Build 1.06 has been released. The following items have been addressed:

[h2]Changes[/h2]
[h3]Keyboard Control Scheme[/h3]
[list]
[*] Jump is space bar.
[*] Line slack is E to match cast.
[*] Upgrade is now the tab key to avoid accidentally ending up in this dialog.
[/list]
[h3]UI[/h3]
[list]
[*] Updated all input icons to be more readable and consistent.
[/list]
[h2]Fixed[/h2]
[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where some action icons would be behind the targeted fish.
[*] Language updates to the tutorial text to be clearer and consistent.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.05 Released
notes.notes:
Build 1.05 has been released. The following items have been addressed:

[list]
[*] Shop lists now update detail section on mouse over rather than just selected item based on keyboard input.
[*] Changed titles of tabs in Shop from Buy/Sell to Buying/Selling to avoid confusion that these must be clicked to complete actions.
[*] Fixed Appearance Dialog face preview to always be aligned with the face. In some cases it was not always aligned in the center.
[*] Fixed Buy/Sell tab highlight color to be standard.
[*] Fixed colors of scrollbars and sliders to be consistent with theme.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.04 Released
notes.notes:
Build 1.04 has been released. The following items have been addressed:

[list]
[*] "Set Lure" action has been renamed "Upgrade" to reflect its actual purpose.
[*] Added Title to "Upgrade" dialog to clarify its for upgrades only.
[*] Tutorial has been updated to clarify the following elements:
[list]
[*] Mouse (with Middle button) can be used for camera control. Both in 3d (rotation and zoom) and 2d (zoom).
[*] Compass has been increased in size and is also shown in tutorial dialog explaining it.
[/list]
[/list]
